name: Bad Habits
overview: Scripture reveals that bad habits defile the heart and separate us from God, as seen in Jesus' warning about the consequences of sin (Matthew 25:41; Mark 7:20). However, salvation through confessing Christ and believing in His resurrection (Romans 10:9) opens the way for transformation. Believers are called to present their bodies as living sacrifices and to be renewed in mind, rejecting conformity to the world in order to discern and follow God's will (Romans 12:1-2). Prayer and thanksgiving provide spiritual strength to overcome anxiety and support the process of breaking bad habits (Philippians 4:6).
